messages:
Evan (growth): Heads-up: we need a single-page external brief that ties secure deploy modes to concrete SLA promises and inbound routing for field. Short, scannable, <350 words.
Priya (product): Target audience: platform + security leads. Must include: micro comparison (Hosted/Dedicated/Private), verified performance snippet, data controls, and engagement steps.
Marcus (eng): Public-safe benchmark line we can use: "Verified typical p95 for 2k generation: Hosted ~265ms; Dedicated (reserved pools) ~195ms; Private: varies by infra; request a custom test." Throughput: Dedicated autoscale supports ~700 reqs/min @512 tokens. Cost ballpark for 1M tokens: $75-110 depending on quant/batching.
Rhea (field): Inbound routing: form tags -> secure_eval / sla_request / private_interest. Automations: secure_eval -> AE-security specialist; private_interest -> solutions-eng + auto-create support ticket; flag gov/healthcare/finance for high-priority routing. Add CRM tag: secure_eval.
Asha (design): I'll design a one-pager: hero micro-table (3 cols), three pillar icons (SLA uptime, Data Controls, Cost predictability), and a slim benchmark strip with Marcus's numbers. Also a tiny migration checklist and webinar CTA. Deliverables: PDF + PNG by EOD tomorrow.
Evan (growth): Webinar angle: "Secure Inference: SLA patterns & migration checklist". Speakers: Priya + Marcus + customer. Schedule in ~3 weeks. CTAs on one-pager: Download PDF, Request tailored benchmark, Register for webinar.
Priya (product): Include a 5-step migration checklist: 1) Compliance scoping 2) Select deploy mode 3) Baseline perf & cost 4) Request tailored benchmark 5) Canary rollout + monitor. Keep it actionable.
Marcus (eng): For legal comfort, include disclaimer: "Measured on representative workloads; contact us for custom benchmarks and SLA specifics." Full benchmark spreadsheet will be internal only.
Rhea (field): SDR/AE playbook: Email 1 - one-pager + clear ask; Email 2 - benchmark tease + webinar invite; Call - offer on-demand benchmark/PoC. Route leads via secure_eval tag and ping #sales-ops for prioritized accounts.
LegalBot: Reminder: Any SLA or uptime commitments require Legal approval. Submit the draft to #legal-review within 24h.
Evan (growth): Action items: Marcus - confirm public benchmark line today; Asha - mock by EOD tomorrow; Rhea - routing matrix + CRM automations; Priya - finalize checklist and webinar plan. I'll produce initial external copy v1 and post here for edits.
Priya (product): Agreed. Keep language conservative and customer-focused.
Rhea (field): I'll prepare a short discovery template for AEs: compliance requirements, data residency, throughput need, SLA target.
Evan (growth): Great. Keep the one-pager scannable and tightly focused. :rocket:
